result_text:
Cancelled purchase orders no longer count in the purchase-orders-per-sales-rep report. The full test suite (`mvn -q -o test`) passes. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case or run your Anna/Bob example.

The change is in the `PURCHASE_ORDERS` entry of the `CustomerAttributedRecords` enum in `DataStore.java`. It now excludes `po.status = 'CANCELLED'`, the same way the sales-order and invoice entries do, and I updated its comment to match. Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

That enum entry is also used by the per-country purchase-order count, so that report now leaves out cancelled purchase orders too. If you want the country report to keep counting them, I can split the entry in two.
